conditions.notes: Same referent (the selection of the third AI observer for lineage difference), but 'lineage' is not the same quantity in the two elements. OBS-0009 selects on lineage as operating organization — Anthropic vs NinjaTech — which is attested and sound, and its nuance honestly concedes residual corpus-level correlation. OBS-0011 shows the ambiguity-set arithmetic needs lineage as weight ancestry, which no registered observer can verify from inside: the builder of the existing pair publicly orchestrates external frontier models, Anthropic's among them, so the weights level may not differ at all. Both elements hold under their own definitions: the choice was the right one to make, and the quantity it was made for remains unmeasured. Not a contradiction — a definitional split the field should carry explicitly until an origin-side declaration closes it.
